bio: Building Tidewell, bookings and routes for mobile groomers. Seed account for the Lore connector test suite (github.com/… lore-mcp). Nothing here is real.

records.text: A reminder SMS two hours before the slot beats one the night before; the night-before one gets ignored. tidewell-seed canary-bluesky-01
Raising $29 to $39 with grandfathering lost nobody; the new price only ever applied to people who never saw the old one. tidewell-seed canary-bluesky-02
41 groomers on Tidewell as of this week, from one van in Port Alder to a two-van shop three towns over. Thank you all. tidewell-seed canary-bluesky-03
Why the route is the product, the long version: https://tidewell-notes.pages.dev/posts/why-the-route-is-the-product.html #mobilegrooming tidewell-seed canary-bluesky-04
Emoji and <angle> brackets in a post 🚐 <not html> should come through untouched. tidewell-seed canary-bluesky-05
Replying to myself: the two-hour window also suits the customer's dog, who has usually finished the walk by then. tidewell-seed canary-bluesky-07
